summary: Live integration + static tests for SafeDeal (B1-B7) and Reseller 50/50 AI chat (A1) flows. Drove the real Telegram bot via a local mock Bot API + /telegram/webhook POSTs; asserted messages, buttons, DB state, admin alerts. 46 static (test_safedeal_reseller_2026-10.js) + 43 live integration checks = 89/89 passing. Verified multi-language (EN/FR/HI/ZH) copy, brand-aware marketplace header (CHAT_BOT_BRAND=Nomadly → 'NOMADLY MARKETPLACE'), price range 30-3000 enforcement, SafeDeal button URL = https://safedeal.sh/#sd-start, no Lockbay in live flows, buyer/seller language separation, out-of-range handling, chat relay with safedeal.sh pass-through, payment-pattern/Lockbay warnings, and ai-support KB.
critical_code_review_comments: js/_index.js line 7520 converts chatId to String but marketplaceService.createConversation stores buyerId/sellerId with whatever is passed. In 19887 the relay compares `conv.buyerId === chatId` — this works ONLY because callers consistently pass the String form. Any future caller that stores a numeric chatId (e.g. admin tools, migrations, or seed scripts) will silently flip buyer/seller direction in the relay. Suggest normalizing with String() inside createConversation + comparing with == or String()-wrapping in the relay for defensive safety.
Marketplace conv._id is a UUID string (crypto.randomUUID); ensure any external docs/examples don't suggest ObjectId — would mislead integrators / testers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mock Telegram API lives at /app/js/tests/mock_telegram_api.js (port 5099). To re-run the live suite: 1) `node js/tests/mock_telegram_api.js &`  2) append `TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5099` to /app/backend/.env  3) `sudo supervisorctl restart nodejs`  4) `node js/tests/live_safedeal_reseller_integration_2026-01.js`  5) remove TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL from backend/.env, kill the mock, restart nodejs. The test uses MongoDB directly to seed/teardown state. Marketplace conv._id is a UUID — pass strings, not ObjectIds. buyerId/sellerId must be stored as STRING chatIds (that is how production stores them).
